messages:
Alice (Finance): Heads-up — planning to roll a pricing A/B experiment next Tue. Need signoffs on: grandfathering rules, billing metadata/line-items, invoice language, and the rollout schedule. Summary: A/B traffic split (A = current, B = new pricing: gen -10%, embeddings +15%), initial 20% canary, 90-day grandfather window for non-contracted customers, committed customers grandfather until contract end. More details below.

Ben (Product): Quick q — can we target cohorts by customer tier / tag? we'll wire feature flag `pricing_v2` and need a flag key for invoices so the billing pipeline can pick it up. Also: do we want experiment to affect only hosted API or Dedicated too?

Carla (Revenue Ops): For billing we'll need: 1) invoice line-item canonical names, 2) `pricing_plan` + `experiment_cohort` metadata on usage rows, 3) mapping of customer_id -> grandfather_until date for reconciler. How do we handle retro credits if a customer is moved into a cheaper cohort mid-billing-cycle?

Dan (Legal): Important: if a customer has an executed commitment (reserved capacity, committed MRR) we cannot change their effective price without an amendment. Need agreed notice language and confirmation that "committed customers" are excluded. Also confirm whether refunds/credits are promised anywhere.

Eva (Sales): Agreed on legal. Sales must get the list of all customers with active commits (MRR or reserved) by Thu. Committed = anything with a signed order / reservation. For enterprise customers we usually want to grandfather fully until contract end. Also want an opt-out route we can offer.

Alice (Finance): Clarifying definitions: committed customers = signed contract with pricing or reserved capacity on file. They get full grandfather until EoC (end of contract). Non-committed customers get 90-day grandfather. Enterprise accounts with explicit sales tag `grandfather=true` can be extended case-by-case. Rollout scope: hosted API first; Dedicated requires a separate config — we'll exclude Dedicated for phase 1.

Ben (Product): Draft price-sheet CSV I plan to push to the pricing service: 
```
cohort,pricing_plan,gen_price_per_1k,embed_price_per_1k,grandfather_days,flag_key
A,legacy,0.0060,0.0120,0,pricing_v2:false
B,new,0.0054,0.0138,90,pricing_v2:true
```
This gives -10% generation price and +15% embeddings. We'll include `experiment_cohort` on usage rows.

Carla (Revenue Ops): Invoice line items I'd prefer: `Model usage - generation (v2)` and `Model usage - embeddings (v2)` for the new cohort, legacy stays `Model usage - generation` etc. For credits: we should avoid automated retro credits in the first rollout; instead create a manual reconciliation run and journal entries if needed (safer). Will prepare a mapping schema: `customer_id,cohort,grandfather_until,contract_id`.

Dan (Legal): Proposed notice blurb for docs/invoice terms: "We will introduce updated pricing for new customers and new usage beginning [date]. Customers with active committed capacity or executed contracts will not see price changes through the end of their contracts. Redwood may offer transitional credits at its discretion." Please review — ideally won't promise automatic refunds.

Alice (Finance): Proposed schedule: 
- Tue 09:00 PT: create feature flag + canary (20% internal)
- 48h monitoring (latency/cost/regressions)
- Expand to 50% external free-tier for 7 days
- If OK, 7-day ramp to full hosted rollout
Approvals needed by Fri EOD so ops/legal/sales can prepare.

Eva (Sales): Sales OK with schedule if we get the grandfather CSV by Thu morning. We'll push to CRM and mark opt-outs. Also request a short FAQ for AE talking points.

deploy-bot: feature flag created: `pricing_v2` (id: ff-pricing-v2). Canary target set: 20% internal. Dashboard: /flags/ff-pricing-v2. Audit log id: deploy-998183.

Carla (Revenue Ops): I'll own invoice changes and the reconciliation run. Action items: Ben -> final price-sheet CSV, Alice -> complete list of committed customers and gating rules, Dan -> approved notice language, Eva -> sales list for grandfather=true. I'll run the manual credits journal and post the ledger entries.

Alice (Finance): Decision for now: 1) Committed customers -> grandfather until contract end (no price change). 2) Non-committed enterprise usage > $5k/mo can be grandfathered for 90 days if Sales tags them `grandfather=true`. 3) No automatic retro credits in phase 1; manual reconciliations only. Please confirm by Fri 5pm PT.

Ben (Product): :thumbsup: will finalize CSV and push to the pricing service today.

Dan (Legal): LGTM on notice language with minor tweak sent to thread via DM; will post final version by Thu.

Eva (Sales): Will provide customer list by Thu 11am PT. Will prepare AE FAQ.

Carla (Revenue Ops): Noted. I'll create a `grandfather_mapping.csv` template and drop it in /shared/finance/pricing-rollouts/ by Wed EOD.

Alice (Finance): Thanks everyone. If no objections by Fri 5pm PT, we'll proceed with the canary next Tue. (reaction :white_check_mark:)
